body.label: Target
body.html: Two adjacent empty spaces within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, create illusory steps in the spaces: willing creatures ignore difficult terrain there, and enemies treat them as difficult terrain. The steps do not support weight over gaps.

surges.html: Add a third connected empty space.
One willing creature in the area gains +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Chaos Thread
rider.html: Gain a Chaos Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: change its Damage type to Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid, Force or Arcane. Conditions do not change.
